test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct meaning of the idiom in bold and italics.

***Our hearts go out*** to the families of the victims of this terrible tragedy.

options.text: To receive or express praise for a job well done
To feel sympathy for someone when they are distressed
Well wishes for a deceased person
To wish for things does not yield to anything

solution: The correct answer is **"To feel sympathy for someone when they are distressed".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] <span style=&q
